title: SUPER 56
description:
WELCOME TO HELLEons ago, SUPER 56 was banned by the Government of Pain and all copies were buried in the Samsara Desert. Cartridges have now been spotted in independent gaming stores throughout Hell. Roommates Kronos and Brones secured their own copy of the game and challenged their neighbor to a high-scoring bet. But, it turns out they're pretty bad at video games. It’s up to you to achieve an S Rank and shut the pesky neighbor up once and for all. 

 

WE ARE THE CHAMPIONSEarn bragging rights as you compete for the top of the worldwide leaderboards. Even after you become a SUPER 56 legend, keep things fresh with Daily Challenges. 

2 - 8 Player COUCH MULTIPLAYER MODEChallenge your friends in our new turn-based multiplayer mode! Configure stages and game rules, then jump into the action. Whether you're hosting a party or enjoying remote play, this mode is sure to test the strength of your friendships.

TRIAL MODEEver wanted to take on bigger challenges? We've got you covered. Explore specialized trials like the stage with the cat on the robot vacuum, now expanded into its own TRIAL MODE with a dedicated leaderboard. Instead of just cleaning up a room, you'll now tackle the entire house.

MIC MODEImmerse yourself in a whole new gaming experience with MIC MODE. Control the entire game using sound! Whether you're using your voice, squeaking dog toys, or even slapping your thigh, SUPER 56 takes on a whole new dimension with this innovative feature.

ACHIEVEMENTS GALOREThere's currently 81 achievements in SUPER 56, and some are easier to unlock than others! Use CAREER MODE to practice the stages and unlock achievements. There's always room for more achievements as we add new features. 

 

Keep pushing your limits and striving for greatness in SUPER 56.

Key Features:• 56 genre-bending mini-games all designed around the press of a single button. 

• Single player campaign. 

• 2-8 player couch co-op (also perfect for Remote Play) 

• Easy to learn, yet hard to master gameplay. 

• Unlockable Mod Stones to change the rules of each playthrough. 

• Daily challenges and Trials add a new challenge to master. 

• References, homages, and ridiculous humor centered around gaming history. 

• Compete on the worldwide leaderboard and earn the ultimate bragging rights. 

• Fully customizable experience with unlockable characters, voice packs, ludicrous phrases, and more. 

• Awesome, genre-changing soundtrack. 

• Achievements galore!
description_short: SUPER 56 challenges players to overcome 56 genre-bending mini-games with the press of a single button. Compete in daily challenges, earn achievements, and destroy high scores. Outlandish chaos awaits you in Hell!
